newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Futures Exch ups margins on two stock futures.
newsitem.headline: HK Futures Exch ups margins on two stock futures.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange said on Friday it was raising margin rates on two stock futures with effect from July 4.
The initial margin for futures contracts on Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd will be raised to HK$20,000 from HK$17,000, while the maintenance margin will be increased to HK$16,000 from HK$13,600.
The initial margin for futures contracts on CITIC Pacific Ltd will be raised to HK$17,500 from HK$15,000, while the maintenance margin will be increased to HK$14,000 from HK$12,000.

The exchange also said the rolling forex market will open as usual from June 28 to July 2 during Hong Kong public holidays, but will close earlier than usual on July 3 and 4 in line with overseas markets.
